inclusions.text: Access to three tombs in the Valley of the Kings
inclusions.source: Sixty-three tombs identified; access to three is included in the standard ticket, with the daily rotation set to manage conservation pressure.

inclusions.text: 09:00 pickup from your hotel in Luxor
inclusions.source: 09:00 pickup from your hotel in Luxor.
Drop-off at your hotel in the late afternoon.

exclusions.text: Nefertari's tomb (extra entry fee, sometimes a separate permit)
exclusions.source: Nefertari's tomb is not included in the price — it can be added on request, and sometimes needs a separate permit as well as the extra entry fee.

exclusions.text: Tutankhamun's tomb (KV62) and Seti I (KV17) require additional tickets
exclusions.source: Tutankhamun's tomb (KV62) and Seti I (KV17) require additional tickets, available separately on site if you want them.
